Mocha Insulated Mug with Temperature Display – Smart, Stylish & Functional

The Mocha Insulated Mug with Temperature Display is designed for modern lifestyles where convenience, style, and performance matter equally. With a generous 500ml capacity, this premium insulated mug keeps your beverages at the ideal temperature while letting you check it instantly through its smart digital display. Whether you’re commuting, working at your desk, or relaxing at home, this mug blends innovation with everyday practicality.

Crafted with a two-tone design featuring a matte brown base and beige ribbed grip, this insulated coffee mug delivers a sophisticated mocha-inspired aesthetic. The ergonomic grip ensures a secure and comfortable hold, while the durable construction makes it perfect for daily use. Built to suit coffee lovers, tea drinkers, and professionals on the go, it is more than just a mug—it’s a smart companion.

Smart Temperature Display for Perfect Sips

One of the standout features of the Mocha Insulated Mug with Temperature Display is its intelligent touch-sensitive lid that shows the real-time temperature of your beverage. No more guessing or accidental burns—simply tap the lid to know when your drink is just right. This feature makes it an ideal smart temperature display mug for both hot and cold beverages.

Advanced Insulation with 500ml Capacity

Designed as a high-performance insulated travel mug 500ml, this product helps maintain beverage temperature for extended periods. Enjoy hot coffee during long meetings or chilled drinks during travel without frequent reheating or cooling. The stainless steel interior enhances thermal retention while preserving taste and freshness.

Built-in Phone Stand for Work & Travel

This mug goes beyond insulation by featuring a practical phone stand integrated into its design. Perfect for video calls, watching content, or following recipes hands-free, it adds functionality rarely found in traditional drinkware. It’s an excellent choice for office desks, remote work setups, and travel use.

Colour Options to Match Your Style

The Mocha Insulated Mug with Temperature Display is available in multiple elegant shades to suit personal and professional preferences:

  • ✔ Coffee
  • ✔ Black
  • ✔ Green
  • ✔ White

Each colour option maintains the same premium finish and ergonomic design, making it suitable for gifting, corporate branding, or personal use.

Key Features & Benefits

  • 500ml insulated mug ideal for coffee, tea, and beverages
  • Smart digital temperature display on lid
  • Two-tone design with matte brown base and beige ribbed grip
  • Integrated phone stand for hands-free viewing
  • Leak-resistant lid for safe travel
  • Durable stainless steel interior
  • Reusable and eco-friendly alternative to disposable cups

Perfect for Everyday & Gifting Needs

This coffee mug with temperature display is ideal for professionals, students, travelers, and fitness enthusiasts. Its modern look and smart features also make it a popular choice for corporate gifts, promotional merchandise, and premium giveaways. The combination of functionality and aesthetics ensures long-term usability and brand value.

If you are looking for a smart insulated coffee mug with phone stand that delivers performance, convenience, and style, this product checks all the boxes. Designed for daily use and built to last, it enhances your drinking experience while fitting seamlessly into your lifestyle.

Why Choose?

Unlike ordinary mugs, the offers intelligent features that elevate everyday hydration. From accurate temperature readings to a comfortable grip and versatile colour options, every detail is crafted with the user in mind. It’s the perfect blend of technology, design, and practicality in one premium insulated mug.
